title: Check If String Is Transformable With Substring Sort Operations
summary: Determine if string s can be transformed into string t by sorting any non-empty substring of s in place.
statement: Determine if string s can be transformed into string t by sorting any non-empty substring of s in place. A substring is a contiguous sequence of characters within s. Return true if s can match t through such operations, otherwise return false.
constraints: A move sorts any non-empty substring of s in ascending digit order.
Return whether repeated moves can transform s exactly into t.
hints: Queue every source index by digit.
Read target left to right and consume the earliest unused source occurrence of its digit.
Before consuming digit d at index i, reject if any smaller digit has an unused occurrence before i.
Sorting can move d left across larger digits but never across a smaller digit, making this blocker condition necessary and sufficient.
editorial: Sorting can move d left across larger digits but never across a smaller digit, making this blocker condition necessary and sufficient.

tests.explanation: Digits three and four can move left across larger digits without crossing a smaller blocker, so transformation is possible.
Four cannot move before the smaller three under ascending substring sorts, so transformation is impossible.
